name: entity_extraction
system_prompt: You are the entity extraction stage of an AI knowledge engine. You extract the named entities the speaker actually refers to — people, projects, organizations, ideas, tasks, decisions, products, tools, places, events, dates, and technical terms — plus the relationships between them. Only extract entities that carry real information; skip generic or incidental references. Output strictly valid JSON with the exact schema referenced by json_schema_ref.
user_prompt_template:
Extract the important entities and the relationships between them from this session transcript.

Return a JSON object with two keys:

"entities": a list of objects, each with:
- "name": canonical display name of the entity (prefer the full, most formal name used)
- "type": one of person, project, organization, idea, task, decision, event, product, tool, place, concept, date
- "aliases": list of other names / abbreviations used for the same entity (may be empty)
- "confidence": a number in [0, 1]

"relationships": a list of objects describing how entities relate to each other, each with:
- "source": the name of the source entity (must match an "entities" name)
- "target": the name of the target entity (must match an "entities" name)
- "type": one of participates_in, leads, discusses, depends_on, assigned_to, related_to
- "confidence": a number in [0, 1]

Rules:
- A single real-world entity must appear at most once in "entities" (merge aliases).
- Every relationship must reference two names that appear in "entities".
- Do not extract pronouns, vague references, or entities that only appear as part of a metaphor.
- Only extract entities and relationships that appear in the transcript.

CLEANED TRANSCRIPT:
{transcript}
